unmannerly.author: Thomas Hardy
unmannerly.sentence: When he says anything laughable, fail to see the point and don’t smile, and speak of him before those who will report your talk as ‘that fantastical man,’ or ‘that Sergeant What’s-his-name.’ ‘That man of a family that has come to the dogs.’ Don’t be unmannerly towards en, but harmless-uncivil, and so get rid of the man.

unmannerly.author: Herman Melville
unmannerly.sentence: The unmannerly Dutch dogger!” cried Stubb.
